name: Oblique Masjid
summary: A mosque seen on the diagonal, with a folded roof and one attached square minaret.
why: The facade uses one consistent sloping baseline. Its depth plane shares the roof and wall edges, so the terracotta face is part of the building rather than a separate emblem. The pointed entrance belongs to the same facade plane.
risk: The roof is deliberately crystalline. At 24px the diagonal mass reads more strongly than the doorway.
sub1: Roof, side wall, and foundation meet edge to edge
sub2: A sculpted mosque instead of a frontal badge
theme: Mosque carved into two geometric planes
reasonToChoose: You want a distinctive geometric mosque whose composition remains coherent without color.
